name: PosterMyWall
description_en:
PosterMyWall is a browser design and marketing service for graphics, video, social posts, email and event promotion. Templates, resizing, brand kits and AI tools feed both downloaded assets and plan-dependent publishing workflows. It is broader than a poster editor, but each channel and output has its own conditions.

A small team can prepare a campaign and reuse its artwork for social, email or print. Free editing does not make every high-resolution/PDF download free, and “unlimited downloads” does not mean unlimited AI or email consumption. Premium stock may also carry asset-specific restrictions, including limits on altering the downloaded composite.
description_zh:
PosterMyWall 是浏览器设计和营销服务，覆盖图形、视频、社交帖子、邮件及活动推广。模板、改尺寸、品牌工具包和AI支持下载素材及按套餐提供的发布流程，范围比海报编辑更广，但各渠道和输出有独立条件。

小团队可准备活动并把图稿复用于社交、邮件或印刷。免费编辑不代表所有高清/PDF下载免费，“无限下载”不等于AI或邮件无限。高级图库还有素材专属限制，包括修改下载合成图的限制。

sections.title_en: One campaign can produce several different deliverables
sections.title_zh: 一个活动可产生多种交付物
sections.en:
The price page combines design templates, image/video editing, social accounts, email campaigns and event pages. A practical example is a restaurant creating an event graphic, a social post and an email from the same approved message. Keep dates, prices and permissions consistent across versions. Designing an email or event page is not proof a message was sent, tickets were sold or a social network accepted the post.

Editorial fit: small marketing teams can evaluate the combined workflow where they otherwise move images among separate tools. A professional print job, a large email program or a payment/ticketing operation still needs its own requirements checked. The pricing page’s comparisons and customer savings are vendor marketing, not independently measured outcomes or a reliable cost comparison for every business.
sections.zh:
价格页把设计模板、图像/视频编辑、社交账户、邮件活动及活动页面组合起来。一个实用例子是餐厅用同一获批信息制作活动图、社交帖和邮件，各版本应保持日期、价格及权限一致。设计邮件或活动页不证明已发送、售票或社交网络已接受帖子。

编辑建议：小营销团队可评估其组合流程，减少在不同工具间搬图；专业印刷、大规模邮件或支付/售票仍需分别核对需求。价格页的工具比较及客户节省金额属于厂商营销，并非独立量化成果或适合所有业务的费用比较。

sections.title_en: Choose the output quality and channel deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确选择输出质量及渠道
sections.en:
A documented PDF workflow starts with a finished design and Download in the editor. The [PDF guide](https://support.postermywall.com/hc/en-us/articles/5170361161997-How-do-I-get-a-PDF-download) says to select a standard/high-resolution image option, change File type to PDF and confirm; Free users purchase an eligible download, while Premium/Plus users have included qualifying outputs. Orders can be retrieved from Order History. A PDF is intended for document/print use rather than being directly posted as a social image.

The July2026 help article lists $2.99/$7.99 image choices, while the current price page says high-resolution downloads start at $5.99 and gives other multipage/video prices. Treat the checkout for the actual design/stock/format as authoritative; do not normalize these conflicting article amounts. Inspect font placement, bleed/trim expectations, resolution and the real file before printing. The Free matrix also caps a file’s free page downloads at ten, despite broader FAQ wording that multipage downloads are free.
sections.zh:
文档中的PDF流程从完成设计后点Download开始。[PDF指南](https://support.postermywall.com/hc/en-us/articles/5170361161997-How-do-I-get-a-PDF-download)要求选标准/高清图片项，把File type改为PDF再确认；Free用户购买相应下载，Premium/Plus包含符合条件的输出，也可从Order History取回。PDF用于文档/印刷，不是直接当社交图片发布。

2026年7月帮助文列$2.99/$7.99图片选项，当前价格页却写高清$5.99起，另有多页/视频价格。因此应以实际设计/图库/格式结账为准，不把冲突金额统一成标准价。印前检查字体位置、出血/裁切、分辨率和真实文件。Free矩阵还把每文件免费页下载限为10页，不能只采用FAQ“多页下载免费”的宽泛表述。

sections.title_en: Monthly plans, social accounts and email allowance
sections.title_zh: 月付方案、社交账户及邮件额度
sections.en:
The normal browser showed one-seat monthly USD Premium $13 and Premium Plus $30, with an option to pay in SGD at checkout. Annual billing and team seat bands are separate; neither was quoted or purchased here. Free has limited downloads, one social account, email design/export without sends and a planner. Premium lists high-quality downloads, scheduling, three connected social accounts, one brand kit, 100 new monthly credits and 3,000 email sends. Premium Plus lists unlimited social accounts/brand kits, branded email addresses, 250 credits and 10,000 sends.

Event resources also differ: the matrix lists two/ten/unlimited monthly event pages for Free/Premium/Plus, while paid ticketing and payment terms require separate review. Do not treat an event-page allowance as a completed payment feature test. A 14-day Premium trial is promoted separately from ongoing Free access; its exact checkout conversion/cancellation terms were not tested.
sections.zh:
正常浏览器显示单席位月付美元Premium $13、Premium Plus $30，并提示结账可付新币。年付及团队席位档独立，本文未报价或购买。Free为有限下载、1个社交账户、邮件设计/导出但无发送，以及规划器。Premium列出高质量下载、排程、3个社交账户、1个品牌工具包、每月100新点数及3,000邮件发送；Plus为无限社交账户/品牌工具包、品牌邮件地址、250点及10,000发送。

活动资源也不同：矩阵列Free/Premium/Plus每月2/10/无限活动页，但付费售票及支付条款需另查，页面额度不等于支付功能实测。网站另宣传14天Premium试用，与长期Free访问不同，其结账转换/取消细则未测试。

sections.title_en: AI cost depends on the operation and surface
sections.title_zh: AI消耗取决于操作及入口
sections.en:
The [September2026 credit guide](https://support.postermywall.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021984251-What-are-Credits) separates included plan credits from purchased packs. It lists image generation at one credit per generation for two images in one section, but PosterMyWall AI chat image creation/editing at two credits per image in another. Editing can also cost two to three credits by complexity. These are context-specific statements; do not promise one universal image rate.

Other listed costs include one credit/image background removal, one credit/second video background removal, three/four credits for image-only/text-plus-image redesign, and seven/ten credits for 720p/1080p video without/with audio or twenty/twenty-four for 4K. Active AI chat can periodically deduct a one-credit processing fee. An email top-up yields 50 or 60 sends per credit depending on pack. Check the quoted operation before running a batch. The guide describes monthly anniversary grants but also says plan credits reset at month start; exact account timing needs confirmation. Unused plan credits expire, while purchased credits do not. Packs are 100/$19, 400/$67, 1,000/$149 or 2,000/$293 in the viewed USD price page.
sections.zh:
[2026年9月点数指南](https://support.postermywall.com/hc/en-us/articles/360021984251-What-are-Credits)区分套餐及购买点数。一处写图片生成每次1点得2图，另一处PosterMyWall AI聊天生成/修改却是每图2点，编辑还可按复杂度耗2至3点。因此这些是特定入口表述，不能承诺统一图片单价。

其他列价包括图像去背景每图1点、视频去背景每秒1点、仅图/图文重设计3/4点，720p/1080p视频无/有音频7/10点，4K为20/24点。活跃AI聊天还可周期扣1点处理费；邮件加量每点50或60封，按包不同。批量前应检查实际操作报价。指南一方面按订阅周年日发放，另一方面又说月初重置，账户具体时间需确认。未用套餐点到期，购买点不失效。本次美元价格页点数包为100/$19、400/$67、1,000/$149、2,000/$293。

sections.title_en: A stock-containing download can restrict later editing
sections.title_zh: 含图库的下载可能限制后续修改
sections.en:
The linked [Getty premium stock agreement](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/premiumcontentagreement) applies specifically to designs purchased with Getty assets. It allows specified commercial use, with a 10,000-unit print/SKU cap and advance notification/additional fees if exceeded. It forbids extracting the stock media or modifying the downloaded composite image/video, and requires retaining notices. This is materially different from treating the download as a reusable stock source or freely recropping it in another tool.

That agreement is not a universal license for every library item. Storyblocks and other sources have separately linked agreements; those were not fully reviewed here. The [nonexclusive design agreement](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/licenseagreement) also grants 250Mils broad operational/promotional/product rights when designs are uploaded/created or published under its scope. Users must have the rights they grant. For client/private work, review both the chosen media license and the applicable content-sharing terms rather than assuming a paid plan transfers exclusive rights.
sections.zh:
链接的[Getty高级图库协议](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/premiumcontentagreement)专门适用于购买含Getty素材的设计。它允许指定商业用途，印刷/SKU上限10,000，超出需提前通知并可能另费；禁止抽取图库或修改下载后的合成图像/视频，要求保留权利通知。这与把下载当可复用图库原件或在其他工具任意再裁切不同。

该协议不覆盖每个库项目，Storyblocks等另有链接协议，本文未完整审查。[非独占设计协议](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/licenseagreement)还对其范围内上传/创建或发布的设计授予250Mils广泛运营/宣传/产品权利，用户必须拥有可授予的权利。客户/私密项目应同时核对所用媒体许可及内容分享条款，不能假定付费转移独占权。

sections.title_en: Keep channel delivery and contract acceptance separate
sections.title_zh: 渠道投递与合同验收分开
sections.en:
The [terms](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/termsofuse) retain proprietary software rights and user-content ownership while granting the provider a broad content license. Their cancellation section excludes refunds for unused subscription time/credits; a separately linked refund policy and the actual order may add relevant conditions. Public design templates and promoted marketing claims are not independent checks of contributor asset rights.

For a campaign, check saved design state, the downloaded file, connected-network permissions, actual post/email delivery and audience consent separately. Do not equate a high-quality download entitlement with unlimited paid AI, email sends or asset rights. No design, generation, download purchase, external publication, email send, event/ticket or cancellation action was performed. Remaining uncertainties are explicit rather than filled with directory pricing or marketing guarantees.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://www.postermywall.com/index.php/info/termsofuse)保留专有软件权利及用户内容所有权，同时授予提供方广泛内容许可；取消章节不退剩余订阅时间/点数，另链接退款政策及实际订单可能有相关条件。公开设计模板和宣传不构成对贡献者素材权利的独立核查。

活动应分别检查保存状态、下载文件、网络权限、真实帖子/邮件投递及受众同意。高质量下载权益不等于付费AI、邮件发送或素材权利无限。本研究未执行设计、生成、购买下载、外部发布、发信、活动/售票或取消；未知项保持明确，不用旧目录价格或营销保证填补。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Credit grant/reset timing, operation-specific prices, actual design/stock checkout, annual/seat/tax/renewal rates, refund policy and non-Getty asset agreements need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 点数发放/重置时间、逐操作价、实际设计/图库结账、年付/席位/税费/续费、退款政策及非Getty素材协议需确认。

research_gaps.en: No design/download, AI run, social connection/publication, email delivery, event/ticket transaction or permission/recovery test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试设计/下载、AI执行、社交连接/发布、邮件投递、活动/售票交易或权限/恢复。
